headline: Housing sector accounted for 5.5% of GDP in 2025; it grew seven times faster than the economy
summary: Housing activity accounted for 5.5% of Mexico's GDP in 2025. Self-construction made up 56.8% of sector activity and grew 8.2% in real annual terms.
why: Housing construction is a major driver of employment and materials demand, and its growth signals household investment in the economy.
original_headline: Sector de la vivienda representó 5.5% del PIB en el 2025; creció siete veces más que la economía
